sloka: क्रौन्च बर्हिण सम्घुष्टे राज हम्स निषेवितैः ।तूर्य आभरण निर्घोषैः  सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम् ॥५-३-११॥
transliteration: kraunca barhiṇa samghuṣṭe rāja hamsa niṣevitaiḥ ।tūrya ābharaṇa nirghoṣaiḥ  sarvataḥ pratināditām ॥5-3-11॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.
translations.hindi: भवनों के द्वारों पर क्रौंच, मोर श्रादि पक्षी सुहावनी बोलियाँ बोल रहे थे । राजहंस भलग ही वहाँ की शोभा बढ़ा रहे थे । सर्वत्र नगाड़ों श्रौर आभूषणों के शब्द सुनाई पड़ते थे
